name: Helix Biosystems Accelerated Bone Grafting System
product_name: Helix Biosystems Accelerated Bone Grafting System
description: A medical system that fabricates custom bone grafts from the patient's own cells in 24 hours and integrates them into the skeletal system through a minimally invasive procedure. The ABGS scans the injury site, 3D-prints a bone scaffold seeded with the patient's osteoblasts, and implants it through a small incision where it bonds with existing bone within two weeks. The technology has made fractures, bone loss, and skeletal augmentation foundation work routine procedures rather than months-long recovery processes.
social_impact: ABGS has made skeletal augmentation accessible by solving the foundation problem — cyberware requires bone strong enough to anchor to, and ABGS can reinforce any skeleton to augmentation-ready specifications. This has expanded the augmentation market significantly while creating new demand for bone-anchored implants that previously required natural skeletal density only a fraction of the population possessed.
story_hooks: An ABGS scaffold has been fabricated with a hollow core containing a data storage device — someone is hiding information inside the bones of a willing or unwilling patient.
A black market ABGS operator is reinforcing skeletons for bare-knuckle fighters — the bone grafts make their fists capable of punching through body armor.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Combat Exoskeleton Lite CEL-3
